与兴趣爱好一起成长(Growing up with hobbies): 一篇关于兴趣爱好的B1记叙文:米娅的经历、感受与成长。

David and Mia are preparing a report about the dance studio. On Saturday evenings, Mia reviews the notes from class. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. For example, the doctor said his liver needs better care.

The experience taught Mia more than any book could. David always says that small steps matter more than big plans. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Also, the single release drops on Friday.
The dance studio looked quieter than usual that evening. Mia wrote down every idea in a small notebook. Mia believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. Also, the encore set added four songs.
There are always more possibilities than we expect. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. Mia keeps a small cat at home and feeds it every morning. Also, she said the shop closes at six.
People around Mia often share different ideas about the dance studio. Mia prefers sunny weather when running in the zoo. Mia thanked David for the honest advice.
